title: Coherent system and geometric coordinates on actual strict quotient towers
statement: For each prime $\ell$ and finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, on the actual strict quotient systems with $R_n=\mathcal O_E/\ell^{n+1}$ there exist Base coordinates $b$ and Operations $o$ [def-sp-strict-compactification-comparison-interfaces] such that every selected calculus $b_T$ is the systems field of semilinear derived sections data [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. For all $r\ge m\ge n$, scalar extension of the scalar/tensor comparison for $r\to m$, followed by that for $m\to n$ and the tensor of scalar associators, equals the scalar associator on the tensor followed by the scalar/tensor comparison for $r\to n$. For every scheme map $f$, scalar extension of its coefficient direct-image mate for $r\to m$, followed by its mate for $m\to n$ and direct image of the source scalar associator, equals the target scalar associator followed by the mate for $r\to n$. The coefficient mates and scalar associators are exactly the normalized ones of the recorded calculus, including equal indices. This assertion does not assert open or compactification word evaluation, finite realization compatibility, or bounded-below compatibility.

proof.text: Construct Base b and Operations o with their semilinear-derived-sections witnesses, without asserting either three-index equation.
Apply the generic scalarTensor_composition theorem to b.calculus T. comparisonLevelTensor is definitionally its recorded level tensor, so this gives the scalar/tensor conjunct unchanged.

Apply coefficientPullback_composition to the generic geometry of each scheme map. Transpose the desired coefficient-mate equation through the level-n adjunction. Counit naturality moves the target scalar associator; mateEquiv_counit removes each of the three mates. Naturality of the intermediate square and source scalar associator reduce the result to the coefficientPullback_composition equation. This proves the geometric mate equation without inverting a mate or assuming derived evaluation is faithful.

theorem strictSystemGeometricRealization :
    ∃ b : Base l E, ∃ o : Operations l E b,
  (∀ T : Scheme.{u},
    ∃ s : SemilinearSections.SemilinearDerivedSectionsData.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (B l E T) (tau l E T), s.systems = b.calculus T) ∧
    (∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) {r m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) (k : m ≤ r)
    (K L : SemilinearSections.D.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (B l E T r)),
    ((b.calculus T).scalar h).T.map
        (((b.calculus T).scalarTensor k).hom.app (K, L)) ≫
      ((b.calculus T).scalarTensor h).hom.app
        (((b.calculus T).scalar k).T.obj K, ((b.calculus T).scalar k).T.obj L) ≫
      (comparisonLevelTensor l E b T n).map
        (Prod.mkHom (((b.calculus T).scalarComposition h k).hom.app K)
          (((b.calculus T).scalarComposition h k).hom.app L)) =
    ((b.calculus T).scalarComposition h k).hom.app
        ((comparisonLevelTensor l E b T r).obj (K, L)) ≫
      ((b.calculus T).scalarTensor (h.trans k)).hom.app (K, L)) ∧
    (∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {r m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) (k : m ≤ r)
    (Q : SemilinearSections.D.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) ((o.geometry f).generic.coefficients r)),
    ((b.calculus Y).scalar h).T.map
        ((comparisonCoefficientMate l E b o f k).app Q) ≫
      (comparisonCoefficientMate l E b o f h).app
        (((o.geometry f).generic.target.scalar k).T.obj Q) ≫
      ((o.geometry f).generic.levelPush n).rightDerivedFunctor.map
        (((o.geometry f).generic.target.scalarComposition h k).hom.app Q) =
    ((b.calculus Y).scalarComposition h k).hom.app
        (((o.geometry f).generic.levelPush r).rightDerivedFunctor.obj Q) ≫
      (comparisonCoefficientMate l E b o f (h.trans k)).app Q)
